name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted scraping engine that passes Cloudflare and other browser challenges and CAPTCHAs, with a native scrape API, a FlareSolverr-compatible /v1 endpoint, MCP tools for AI agents and a metrics dashboard.

alerts.message: TRAWL has no API authentication, so this template only answers under a secret path. Use https://<your-domain>/<TRAWL_TOKEN>/ as the FlareSolverr URL in Prowlarr or Jackett, https://<your-domain>/<TRAWL_TOKEN>/scrape for the native API and https://<your-domain>/<TRAWL_TOKEN>/mcp as the MCP endpoint, where the token is the generated value in the environment settings. The dashboard at https://<your-domain>/dashboard asks for the same token. Keep it private: anyone who has it can make the server browse any URL.
On x86_64 servers the standard image needs a CPU with AVX2. On older CPUs or NAS hardware, switch the trawl image to ghcr.io/germondai/trawl:1.11.1-baseline.
